input.summary:
Lobby stair hall furnished in parts/room-1.mjs: coat post, lantern and boot bench by the front door, boot barrel with flower pot, and a table (fence + slab, candle) with chair south of the stair foot; the lane x5..6 stays clear.
Lit by 8 hanging lanterns (lane centre and west column, one over the table) plus standing lanterns on the coat post and the boot barrel; room check OK: walk 69 of 70 reachable, min light 7, 0 dark, 8 dim.
make.sh builds a whole build.nbt with 17 blocks for this part, no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE writes; room.png rendered and read (the view from above shows the stair, not the furniture at this scale).
left: plan.md's checklist has no room-1 entry, so nothing was ticked; elements.md item 24 (lighting) is shared with the hearth part and was not ticked.
The one unreached cell (x7, z21) is the barrel top, which the standing lantern now occupies; it is not a floor cell anyone needs, but the room check still lists it as unreached.
8 floor cells remain at light 1-7 (the room check suggests a standing lantern at 5,6,11, which would block the lane, so it was not added).

waste.what: Wrote the furniture layers by counting blank rows by hand; two layouts had off-by-one rows, found only after the first build.
waste.cost: 1 rewrite of the module, about 3 minutes
waste.tool: A layers() helper keyed by z (rows given as a map of z -> row text, blanks filled) so each row is pinned to its coordinate; I wrote one locally in room-1.mjs.

waste.what: Tuned the lantern positions by rebuilding and re-running the room check four times, moving one lantern at a time to clear the dim cells.
waste.cost: 4 make.sh + room check cycles, about 4 minutes
waste.tool: mcd room could print the best combined set of lamp spots (all dim cells lifted to 8+) rather than only the single best lamp, so the lanterns could be placed in one pass.

waste.what: Checked by eye which floor cells a standing lantern on a barrel top would block for the walker, by rebuilding and reading the unreached list.
waste.tool: mcd room's unreached list could name the blocking block (lantern on barrel top) rather than only the cell coordinates.

companions.task: Light the 8 remaining dim floor cells (1-7) without putting a lamp in the lane: hidden light under the first-floor floor or a lantern tucked on the coat post side, so every cell is 8+.
Make the table and chair as real joinery (a fence table with a slab top, a stair chair) and check their facing against the stair foot, so the furniture reads as made rather than placed.
